items.title: Google's AI reshuffle: Chief scientist Jeff Dean exits and Demis Hassabis steps down as DeepMind CEO

items.title: Salad and Go files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy after cyclospora fears worsened its challenges

items.title: Manager of DRAM memory chip stock trade blockbuster ETF is back with new AI thematic bet
items.description: Roundhill Investments' DRAM became a blockbuster ETF in record time on the memory trade. It's back with a new fund targeting another AI tech theme: photonics.

items.title: Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Democratic Senate primary as voters pivot to the left

items.title: Uber stock sinks 7% after weak guidance despite revenue growth

items.description: Employers have grappled with soaring demand for GLP-1 drugs such as Ozempic and Wegovy, which can cost thousands of dollars per patient annually.

items.description: Eli Lilly now expects 2026 revenue to come in between $85 billion and $87 billion, up from previous guidance of $82 billion to $85 billion.
